<h2 class="gb-text gb-text-eb57cee3">Frequently Asked Questions</h2>


<div class="c-faq wp-block-launchpad-faq" data-faq data-first-open>
	
<div class="c-faq-item wp-block-launchpad-faq-item" data-faq-item>
	<h3 class="c-faq-item__heading">
		<button type="button" id="c-faq-trigger-3" class="c-faq-item__trigger" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="c-faq-panel-2">
			<span class="c-faq-item__question">What is Locus Robotics?</span>
			<span class="c-faq-item__icon" aria-hidden="true">
				<svg width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" focusable="false">
					<path class="c-faq-item__icon-h" d="M5 12h14" />
					<path class="c-faq-item__icon-v" d="M12 5v14" />
				</svg>
			</span>
		</button>
	</h3>
	<div id="c-faq-panel-2" class="c-faq-item__panel" role="region" aria-labelledby="c-faq-trigger-3" hidden>
		<div class="c-faq-item__answer">Locus Robotics helps the world’s leading brands automate fulfillment without sacrificing flexibility. By combining intelligent robots, AI-driven orchestration, and optimized workflows in one platform, we enable operators to increase throughput, adapt to changing business demands, and continuously improve performance across every workflow. Headquartered globally in Wilmington, Massachusetts, with regional headquarters in Amsterdam, Locus Robotics designs, builds, and deploys Physical AI systems that are transforming fulfillment around the world.</div>
	</div>
</div>


<div class="c-faq-item wp-block-launchpad-faq-item" data-faq-item>
	<h3 class="c-faq-item__heading">
		<button type="button" id="c-faq-trigger-5" class="c-faq-item__trigger" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="c-faq-panel-4">
			<span class="c-faq-item__question">What makes Locus Robotics different?</span>
			<span class="c-faq-item__icon" aria-hidden="true">
				<svg width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" focusable="false">
					<path class="c-faq-item__icon-h" d="M5 12h14" />
					<path class="c-faq-item__icon-v" d="M12 5v14" />
				</svg>
			</span>
		</button>
	</h3>
	<div id="c-faq-panel-4" class="c-faq-item__panel" role="region" aria-labelledby="c-faq-trigger-5" hidden>
		<div class="c-faq-item__answer">Most automation is built around fixed infrastructure. Locus Robotics is built around flexibility.<br>Our Flexibility-First Automation platform combines collaborative and fully autonomous robots, AI-driven orchestration, and optimized workflows in a single platform delivered through a Robots-as-a-Service model. That means you get all the benefits of automation but with faster deployment, minimal upfront investment, and ROI measured in months, not years.<br>Deploy our solutions in existing facilities with virtually no downtime or infrastructure changes, then scale and adapt as volumes, workflows, and business needs evolve. One platform. Every workflow. Unmatched flexibility.</div>
	</div>
</div>


<div class="c-faq-item wp-block-launchpad-faq-item" data-faq-item>
	<h3 class="c-faq-item__heading">
		<button type="button" id="c-faq-trigger-7" class="c-faq-item__trigger" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="c-faq-panel-6">
			<span class="c-faq-item__question">What is LocusONE<span class="c-tm">®</span>?</span>
			<span class="c-faq-item__icon" aria-hidden="true">
				<svg width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" focusable="false">
					<path class="c-faq-item__icon-h" d="M5 12h14" />
					<path class="c-faq-item__icon-v" d="M12 5v14" />
				</svg>
			</span>
		</button>
	</h3>
	<div id="c-faq-panel-6" class="c-faq-item__panel" role="region" aria-labelledby="c-faq-trigger-7" hidden>
		<div class="c-faq-item__answer">LocusONE® is the intelligent software platform that acts as the central brain for the Locus Robotics fleet. It integrates directly with your existing Warehouse Management System (WMS) to dynamically route, manage, and orchestrate multiple types of autonomous robots in real time. By utilizing proprietary swarm AI, LocusONE® optimizes picking paths, tracks live facility performance, and coordinates tasks between humans and robots to maximize warehouse throughput.</div>
	</div>
</div>


<div class="c-faq-item wp-block-launchpad-faq-item" data-faq-item>
	<h3 class="c-faq-item__heading">
		<button type="button" id="c-faq-trigger-9" class="c-faq-item__trigger" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="c-faq-panel-8">
			<span class="c-faq-item__question">What is RaaS?</span>
			<span class="c-faq-item__icon" aria-hidden="true">
				<svg width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" focusable="false">
					<path class="c-faq-item__icon-h" d="M5 12h14" />
					<path class="c-faq-item__icon-v" d="M12 5v14" />
				</svg>
			</span>
		</button>
	</h3>
	<div id="c-faq-panel-8" class="c-faq-item__panel" role="region" aria-labelledby="c-faq-trigger-9" hidden>
		<div class="c-faq-item__answer">Locus Robotics’ Robots-as-a-Service (RaaS) model eliminates the need for large upfront automation investments, allowing customers to deploy, scale, and optimize automation through a predictable operating expense. Every subscription includes continuous software innovation, ongoing operational optimization, maintenance, and 24/7 support, ensuring the system becomes more productive, capable, and valuable over time.</div>
	</div>
</div>


<div class="c-faq-item wp-block-launchpad-faq-item" data-faq-item>
	<h3 class="c-faq-item__heading">
		<button type="button" id="c-faq-trigger-11" class="c-faq-item__trigger" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="c-faq-panel-10">
